Return the vector of 990 + 990-EZ financial field names (PZ scope)

Source: R/globals.R
get_pz_fields.Rd

Returns financial fields that appear on both the full Form 990 and the 990-EZ (Part I summary fields). Zero-imputation via sanitize_financials() is applied to these fields for all filers.

Usage

get_pz_fields()

Value

A character vector of column names.

Examples

get_pz_fields()
#>  [1] "F9_01_EXP_BEN_PAID_MEMB_CY"       "F9_01_EXP_GRANT_SIMILAR_CY"      
#>  [3] "F9_01_EXP_OTH_CY"                 "F9_01_EXP_OTH_CY_V2"
